additions.name: China Unicom Tianjin Jing-Jin-Ji Park South Zone DC1 / DC2

status.summary: The participating consultant’s September 9 report confirms the south-zone DC1/DC2 operating-management certification and service context. This is dated confirmation of an existing operating project, not a new opening or the original certification award day. It does not characterize the north-zone fit-out.

locator.precision: Representative point within a named mapped China Unicom Jing-Jin-Ji park area. Campus locator only; does not identify a DC1/DC2 building footprint, the south-zone boundary or a surveyed full-campus centroid.
locator.identity_review: OSM way1263404569 is explicitly named 中国联通京津冀数字科技产业园项目数据中心一期. Contractor CSCEC places the identically named south-zone project at Gaocun Technology Innovation Park, Wuqing, Tianjin; the direct consultant identifies DC1/DC2 as the south-zone facilities, and the operator report distinguishes north and south at this campus. The arithmetic bounding-box center is checked inside the mapped polygon. OSM phase name does not establish a legal phase boundary or lifecycle state.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Community mapping has no measured positional accuracy. Exact DC1/DC2 building positions and distance from this campus marker are unknown; coordinate decimals reflect calculation, not survey accuracy.

additions.distinctness_review: Reviewed all 423 base projects, 399 sites and 231 complete imported records for Unicom, Tianjin, Wuqing, Jing-Jin-Ji and Chinese aliases; no match. Nearest existing marker is China Mobile International Information Port Beijing, 78.163 km away. DC1 and DC2 are retained as one south-zone project at one physical campus. The north zone is distinct scope and receives no additional counted record in this packet.
additions.successor_review: Checked primary consultant report and live certifier registry on October 13. No subsequent closure or cancellation found. September 30 press coverage concerns north-zone MEP installation, and is not a reversal of south-zone operation. No north/DC3 project is inferred or counted.

additions.site_name: Kobe Former Conveyor Tunnel Data Center
additions.name: Kobe Former Conveyor Tunnel Data Center Initial Development

status.summary: Joint developer announcement identifies a commercial data center in the awarded former conveyor tunnel section, with initial service targeted for end-2027. Existing tunnel, September 4 award and announced development do not establish achieved physical DC construction.

locator.precision: Approximate D4 machine-room symbol centre within the named leased host-tunnel section. It locates the parent underground facility only; no surveyed portal, tunnel footprint, container installation point or building boundary is established.
locator.identity_review: Kobe city award identifies approximately 3 km from Komi to Mitsugaoka and directly links the map highlighting D4 machine room, D4 tunnel and D3 machine room. The selected D4 circle lies within that exact map scope. Nineteen distributed controls register the official diagram to GSI tiles. The coastal locator for the full 14.5-km conveyor system is explicitly excluded.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The municipal diagram does not state geodetic or surveyed accuracy and uses a large symbolic room marker. A low registration residual does not establish ground accuracy. Rounded four-decimal coordinates identify the host-tunnel area only.

additions.distinctness_review: All 399 baseline sites, 423 projects and source records checked for Kobe, conveyor and Getworks; no existing project/site match. Nearest mapped site is SoftBank Osaka Sakai AI data center about 35.20 km away. One awarded host-tunnel section and one initial-development project; D3/D4 rooms and eventual containers are not separately counted.
additions.successor_review: Primary city and developer pages reviewed October 13; October 6 remains the latest dated named-project announcement established in this bounded pass. End-2027 service and eventual maximum 20 MW receiving capacity remain prospective. No later achieved physical works or operation observation established.

scoped_project_details.capacity_scope: Future maximum receiving capacity only; no selected live IT load or delivered capacity.
scoped_project_details.locator_scope: Approximate D4 host-tunnel symbol, not an installation or portal survey

additions.name: Aligned Project Phoenix / PIT-01 Campus Development

status.summary: Operator announces the named three-facility campus and September 10 groundbreaking. Retain announced as the latest exact-day supported lifecycle classification: undated site-operations and planned-blasting text has no exact achieved work observation, and the October 8 legal commencement filing is not such an observation.

locator.precision: Main entrance marker for the parent Shippingport Industrial Park property. It does not locate an individual Aligned building, the three-facility campus centroid, construction work limits or a legal parcel boundary.
locator.identity_review: Aligned explicitly identifies Project Phoenix inside Shippingport Industrial Park. The named property website embeds the exact map whose unique Main Site Entrance point is selected. Its 128 Ferry Hill Road address differs from Aligned PIT-01 address 100 Church Lane; no exact address match is claimed. State filing independently links the named Aligned project to Shippingport parcels. Adjacent power-station equipment is not selected as the DC location.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Source gives no measured positional accuracy. Offset from the parent entrance to individual proposed DC buildings is unknown; decimal precision is not survey accuracy.

additions.distinctness_review: Checked all 423 project rows, 399 sites and 231 preserved source records for Shippingport, Bruce Mansfield, Project Phoenix, PIT-01 and Steel Curtain. No match. Nearest existing site is Bitdeer Weathersfield (Niles), 67.24 km away. One campus project and one physical site; the three facilities are not counted separately, and the adjacent power station is not a DC project.
additions.successor_review: As of October 13: reviewed operator announcement, facility and community pages and October 8 state filing. Later undated community schedule gives proposed blasting dates, not achieved works; filing reports permit numbers without grant dates or approved scope. No newer exact-day physical construction/completion/operation observation established. Announced is a conservative evidence classification, not a claim that no site work has occurred.

scoped_project_details.capacity_scope: Developer headline; IT-versus-facility power unspecified, planned not delivered

integration_review.campus_markers: User reconfirmed clearly labelled campus and parent-property markers. Each admission must distinguish its host locator from building footprints and legal boundaries.
integration_review.date_semantics: Separate current-operation confirmation from original opening dates. Announced status does not establish construction, and procurement/ceremonies/planned work dates do not supply an achieved physical work observation.
integration_review.source_preservation: Earlier published datasets remain immutable; imported source-records and identity-mapping must remain byte-identical.
